entries.title: I Timothy 4:1
segments: ¶Now the Spirit expressly says that in latter times some will depart from the faith, giving heed to deceiving spirits and doctrines of demons,

entries.title: I Timothy 4:2
segments: speaking lies in hypocrisy, having their own conscience seared with a hot iron,

entries.title: I Timothy 4:3
segments: forbidding to marry, [and commanding] to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:4
segments: For every creature of God [is] good, and nothing is to be refused if it is received with thanksgiving;

entries.title: I Timothy 4:5
segments: for it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:6
segments: ¶If you instruct the brethren in these things, you will be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished in the words of faith and of the good doctrine which you have carefully followed.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:7
segments: But reject profane and old wives' fables, and exercise yourself toward godliness.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:8
segments: For bodily exercise profits a little, but godliness is profitable for all things, having promise of the life that now is and of that which is to come.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:9
segments: This [is] a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptance.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:10
segments: For to this [end] we both labor and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is [the] Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:12
segments: Let no one despise your youth, but be an example to the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:13
segments: Till I come, give attention to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:14
segments: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the eldership.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:15
segments: Meditate on these things; give yourself entirely to them, that your progress may be evident to all.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:16
segments: Take heed to yourself and to the doctrine. Continue in them, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
